drugs.name: Baricitinib
drugs.mechanism: Selective reversible JAK1 and JAK2 inhibitor blocking IFN-gamma and IL-15 signaling to restore hair follicle immune privilege
drugs.efficacy: Achieves >=80% scalp hair coverage (SALT score <=20) in ~35-40% of severe AA patients
drugs.adverse_effects: Upper respiratory tract infections, headache, acne, hyperlipidemia, urinary tract infections

drugs.name: Ritlecitinib
drugs.mechanism: Covalent inhibitor of JAK3 and the TEC kinase family blocking gamma-c cytokine signaling and CD8+/NK cytolytic function
drugs.efficacy: First FDA-approved treatment for severe alopecia areata in adults and adolescents 12 years and older
drugs.adverse_effects: Headache, nasopharyngitis, upper respiratory tract infection, acne, folliculitis

drugs.name: Triamcinolone Acetonide
drugs.mechanism: Glucocorticoid receptor agonist locally suppressing peri-follicular lymphocytic infiltration
drugs.efficacy: First-line standard of care for patchy alopecia areata involving <50% scalp
drugs.adverse_effects: Localized skin atrophy, telangiectasia, pain on injection, transient hypopigmentation
